While moving through the craft, checking robots and computer panels, you are met with unexpected challenges!

142743.overview:
Dux is a simple shooting gallery game spiced up with a certain duck flavour, obviously inspired by UPL's Carnival. You have a gun mounted at the bottom of the screen. Above are three rows of targets moving around. The targets consist of rabbits, owls, duck and boxes with numbers. You move your gun left and right in order to hit the targets, and you earn more scores for hitting those on the higher rows. You have a limited amount of bullets, but hitting the numbered boxes add more to your arsenal. While the rabbits and owls require just one hit, the ducks will change colours several times before being eliminated. When only five targets remain, the screen changes colour and they must be hit before they leave the screen forever. As you progress, the speed is elevated.

This was a sub-game included with Lotus Turbo Challenge 2,

It is actually an older game called Duck Shoot that was originally released on the VIC-20 by Mr. Chip Software (which was the original name of Magnetic Fields during their 8-bit years).

143896.overview:
Dames Simulator is a computerized version of the famous board game called Checkers. The objective, as in all checkers games, is eat all the enemy pieces, before than the opponent.

In Dames Simulator the player has the opportunity to select the color of his pieces (Black or white), the enemy level (between nine levels), the strategy (Defensive or offensive). The player can also save the game in any moment. During the game, the player has the possibility to use the hint option, for advice on the best move to make.

143905.overview:
Das Magazin is a managerial simulation in which the player responsible for a monthly computer magazine. Each month a sales ranking is calculated and the goal is to achieve a good place. Depending on the ranking a certain amount of points is awarded and if the quota is failed after a year, the player gets fired. In turn a successful year may result in a bigger budget.

The gameplay is completely menu based and consists of changing setting screws. The most important thing to do is hiring staff (editor in-chief, editors and a foreign correspondent) and buying their working equipment. The magazine concept includes both the content (the covered computers and key subjects) and other aspects (e.g. number of printed issues, the used paper or the price). Of course this also depends on the budget and the staff at hand. Other options are marketing and speculating on the exchange market.

143906.overview:
Das Stundenglas (“The hourglass”) is the first of three interactive fiction games by German developer Weltenschmiede (the others being Die Kathedrale and Hexuma - Das Auge des Kal). It is entirely in German.

Upon jumping into a mysterious chest, you arrive in a beautiful fairy-tale world. Yet the serenity is spoiled: the enchanted hourglass that controls the flow of time is lost, and the world has been split into two realities. Both planes are the very same land, but certain buildings and people exist only in one of the two zones. On your quest to reclaim the missing artefact, you will have to travel between the two worlds and claim a magical coin from each of the twelve inhabitants; of course, all of them ask a little favor in return for their gift…

The game contains a (generous) time limit; you have to find the hourglass in 24 days. Consequently, there is a day-night-rhythm, and the characters will wander between certain locations in a daily routine. There are two graphics for most locations to reflect day and night.

143907.overview:
A very short point and click "adventure" game. You attempt to meet and seduce a young red-headed woman named "Vida".

The graphics in this game are (for the most part) digitized still pictures of an actual model; while sexual in nature, they never rise above the level of softcore.

The gameplay is incredibly simplistic, and it can be very hard to make a wrong move- typically, if you make an error, the game just gives a brief quip regarding why a move didn't work, and then returns you to the exact same point to try again.

143947.overview:
Delivery Agent is a managerial simulation in which between one and four players take control over a forwarding agency. The goal is to get as successful as possible within a time frame between a half and five years which is set before starting a new game. The basic way to gain money is to buy vehicles (trucks, planes and ships) and accept missions from customers. There are various things to consider, including the kind of load (certain ones require special vehicles and/or vehicles), the time frame, the capacity (a good workload is good for the balance, but delays cause contract penalties) and the route. Trucks can be upgraded (e.g. with a refrigerator wagon) or repaired.

Of course there are various other options available, too: advertisement to reach new customers, sabotaging the competition, illegal goods, opening repair outposts, taking a loan or stock trading. Also important is the image of the company which is hurt when illegal actions come to the light. The interface is completely menu-based.

143948.overview: You have to build up a trading company in this game. The only way of transport available is by ship. There are 100 harbours wih 32 different goods available. You can design you own ships when you've got enough money for it. But be patient on spending it, a little storm can cost you your existence if you're playing without thinking. Also other happenings like UN-embargos, quarantines or fees for menacing the nature can take effect of your business.

143949.overview:
In Der Produzent: Die Welt des Films the player is a film producer. The goal is to earn one billion Deutschmark within 20 years by producing and marketing popular movies.

The first step in making a picture is of course the script which is either purchased under several scripts for sale or as a commissioned work. The next step is to employ actors and a director with values in different character traits as charisma or experience. Besides the obvious budget restrictions the player has to consider antipathies, e.g. a vain actor might not want to work under a inexperienced director. Then the player has to rent one of six studios and one of four recording studio. The last action is to set the budget of the movie in six categories such as special effects and scenery. During the shooting there is the possibility of several random events, e.g. a fire or arguments between the actors.

After the making comes the marketing of the movie. Costly is the direct marketing in movie theaters or video stores. Then the player has to care for advertising in TV, radio or magazines. On the other hand extra cash can be made with the official CD or video game. Easier is it to sell the movie to a TV station or sell the whole rights to another publisher.

The main menu is a picture of a office. There the player chooses his actions respectively submenu either by clicking on the corresponding office items or the icon bar. Every action costs time and after a certain time the round, which represents one day, ends.

143950.overview:
Diablo is a puzzle game with similarities to sliding block puzzles. Each level is composed of a number of tiles and every one has a part of a pipe (straight or angular) on it - except one which is just a black hole. In one tile a red ball starts rolling and all tiles it rolls through become blank.

The goal of each level is to let the ball roll through all pipe parts without meeting the hole or a blank tile. To ensure this, the player can move the parts while using the hole as buffer. So, as example, if the player clicks on a tile which is a few tiles away from the hole, all tiles between the clicked tile and the hole are moved by one towards the hole. Then the hole is at the place where the player clicked on. At the start of a puzzle, rolling out of the level boundaries is also deadly, but after a certain amount of tiles are cleared the ball comes out at the opposite side of the playfield.

143952.overview:
Die Kathedrale is German interactive fiction with graphics.

The second of three German text adventure games by developer Weltenschmiede, Die Kathedrale ("The Cathedral") confronts you with a mystery centuries old and fiendishly dangerous -- located in a majestic cathedral.

By bad luck, you have been locked in the fictional cathedral of St. Peter, an impressive architectural masterpiece that has a disturbing history of inquisition and dark secrets. Even worse, a set of ancient documents tells you that you have but three days to find and disarm 15 devilish mechanisms that the medieval architect Victor Paz has hidden throughout the ancient building. The parchments give one vague clue to each mystery, but many others are concealed within the church. Why does the great organ have one lever more than it has records? Why did Victor Paz have a well drilled in the catacombs? Could the rumor of a hidden spiral staircase in one of the big columns be true? With an eye for details and an alert mind, you will uncover secrets almost everywhere in the awe-inspiring building.

Fortunately, you are not alone: the cheerful Dani accompanies you on your quest. As you travel back in time with every step into the cathedrals past, Dani is first replaced by the butler Jasper, then by the medieval monk Daniel. Your companions are vital for your progress; not only do they provide clues and carry surplus equipment, but you may also give them specific orders to help you solve puzzles: on your command, they will go to any location, operate machinery or help you move things that are too heavy for one person alone.

143953.overview:
Die Stadt der Löwen (City of Lions) is a follow-up to the first so-called Artventure game by Phoenics and Software 2000, Holiday Maker. A woman named Christine travels to the Orient. She stays in Singapore, enjoying the city life, its inhabitants, and the Asian culture. However, soon this relaxing trip turns into a nightmare. A mysterious force is threatening Singapore, and it is up to you to find out what is behind it and to solve the mystery, that will take you across many locations of the Orient.

Like its predecessor, Die Stadt der Löwen features digitized pictures of live actors and real backgrounds. The interaction is performed via an icon-based interface. The game also contains some erotic images.

143954.overview:
Drachen von Laas tells the story of two young friends who are bored with their everyday life in the medieval fantasy world of Laas. They decide to leave their little village and seek adventures. Adventures they find when they are asked to kill two mighty dragons that rampage the area of a far-away city.

This is a text/graphic adventure with a serious role-playing slant. Although still fashioned with a text parser etc, this game includes a character leveling system, character attributes, role-playing-like combat, a magic system and many other unique elements.

143963.overview: This addon for Test Drive II features 5 legendary cars like a 1963 Corvette Sting Ray, a 1968 Shelby GT500 Cobra, a 1967 Pontiac GTO, a 1969 COPO 9560 ZL-1 Camaro and a 1969 Dodge Charger Daytona. As usual the original game is needed to enjoy the addon.

143968.overview: This expansion disk for The Clue! adds 8 new locations to explore (including Buckingham Palace, Madame Tussaud's wax museum, a train carrying valuables, or that particular London address: 221B Baker Street), more cars and specialists to hire. There are other improvements as well (as those in the planning phase).

143971.overview: In a far-off land, an evil force is in charge, and you set off with the intention of putting things right. Immediately you see signs of desolation and environmental failure, with lifeless and malnourished people all round. Still, you must not give up; your friend who lives amidst this needs your help. With full graphical depiction of events and places, this interactive fiction can be played purely using the keyboard, but the bottom half of the screen contains some mouse interaction for direction entry. You can move in four directions, examine and take objects, talk to people and solve puzzles.

143972.overview:
A dark lord called TITE-ARZ conquers the kingdom and installs a reign of terror (that increases inflation to 59% and causes general unemployment on the population). In order to defeat him, a mighty warrior must find the magical amethyst stone that was stolen from the alchemist's tower.

Dungeons, Amethysts, Alchemists 'n' Everythin' is a text adventure with graphics - a parody of fantasy genre conventions that relies heavily on semi-adult puns for comedy. Written using Graphic Adventure Creator (which the game also parodies), it has a very basic parser, without most of the standard features of other parsers at the time (like the older and superior Infocom one). It does not support chain commands or pronoun recognition and has a very limited vocabulary.

144027.overview: Dingsda is based on the German TV game show of the same name. The game can be played by up to four players.

144251.overview:
Die Fugger is an economy simulation combining elements of games like Kaiser and Hanse. Up to six players can compete on one machine.

You're an impoverished nobody in Germany in the year 1500. However, the death of an uncle leads you to inherit 20 barrels of beer and 500 Talers of money. Start your career heading forwards to getting an renowned and rich member of the society. There are six goods to trade, across 11 different cities. But there's a lot more to do then only trading with goods: attack your opponents or bribe them or build alliances with other players.

144297.overview: Das Haus is an economical simulation in which the player owns an apartment building with 30 flats. The goal is to earn as much money as possible. The player has various opportunities to influence the earnings respectively keep the house running, e.g. buying fuel oil, changing the rent, renovate the house or invest in land or industry. There are various unforeseen occurrences to spice things up a bit, e.g. house damage, moving tenants or a lottery winning.

145875.overview:
A game very much like the Stratego board game where you arrange your different characters on the board, each with special types of attacks and take on an opponent who has done the same. The intent is to find the Stone of Power hidden amongst your opponent's pieces before they find yours. Once upon a time in a far-off world of gods full of magic and dangers in the year 321 after Parton...

“That’s enough!” fumed Tenom, the Father of the Gods. “This damned vermin has finally gone too far. We've had no peace since the death of Parton. The war between the kingdoms of Viaroid and Picom has now been going on for 320 years. The rulers have been begging me to bring them victory over the enemy ever since this time.”

On the same day, Tenom summoned the rulers to him and said: “The decisive battle for the two kingdoms is to take place on a small unimportant island. Each kingdom can send its best warriors, magicians, beasts and demons, 30 in all, to fight the battle for glory, honour and ultimately a united kingdom. The battle is won when the stone of power is torn from the enemy king. Now it’s up to you to bravely and skilfully lead your armies to victory. May the best man win...”

148382.overview:
In Dragon Scape, the player takes the role of a young man who gets magically transported into the land Tuvania. The peace has been disturbed by the evil King of Kaos who has to be defeated. The protagonist has to ride a dragon, find 40 artifacts and bring them to the corresponding places. The artifacts can only be dropped at the correct location.

Of course there are enemies which try to stop the player and can be destroyed by using the dragon's fire breath. Besides the artifact collecting, the game plays out as a traditional multi-directional scrolling shooter. There are five levels with eight artifacts each.

148383.overview:
Those nasty viruses have returned. Dr. Mario, vitamin pills in hand, is ready to eliminate them once more. In addition to the ever-popular 2-player game, now you can challenge the computer in the guise of the Blue, Yellow or Red Virus. A direct clone of a NES original, Dr Mario gives one or two players the chance to play doctor in a Tetris-y pill-rotating fashion. Variously - colored germs are scattered around the play area and must be wiped out
by dropping pills to create lines of four matching colors horizontally or vertically.

Played alone, the game is one of (more or less) quiet concentration. Adding a second player, however, transforms the dynamic entirely: it becomes a ruthless battle where anything goes. The small but key factor responsible is that completing lines on your  side means random gunk gets dropped on your opponent's side, messing everything up. The graphics are better than the somewhat weedy ones of the original, and the music is a distinct improvement over the NES's beepy tunelets. A fine two-player game, Dr Mario can nonetheless cause tempers to flare so have fun, but remain friends!

151275.overview:
Drip is a cool drop and he's partying. Some dastardly person/thing has tapped into his network of pipes and has stopped his supply of party juice so Drip has to race around all the pipes and rust them in order to restore the flow. 

So the objective in this game is to travel round a pipe network covering every pipe within a time limit. Naturally this is too easy so there are obstacles and problems to overcome so apart from the bad guys chasing him Drip has to avoid acid, plasma, ice-cubes, electric bubbles and lasers as contact with any of these will cost a life. There are also fluffy clouds which, when they touch a pipe will un-rust it.
There are a couple of things that will aid Drip, he can travel off the top/bottom/edge of the screen and re-appear at the other side, stars occasionally appear on the screen and these give him a shield which kills enemies on contact, and then there are the party balloons. Balloons are essential on some levels, catching one allows Drip to float around the screen free of the pipe network, thus he can bypass his pursuers but more importantly he can reach pipe sections that are not connected to the rest of the network.

The game has sixteen levels which appear in a random order apart from the final boss level. The levels are themed Acid, Ice and Fire and are coloured green, blue and orange accordingly.

156016.overview:
Tower of Souls is set in the land of Chaybore in which seven crystals are responsible for the well being of its citizen. But the evil demon Baalhathrok has taken them and so the player controls Treeac to retrieve them.

In an isometric view, Treeac has to conquer the seven floors of Baalhathrok's tower. The player controls a ball with his mouse and clicks where Treeac should go. Fights are initiated with left clicking on the enemy, for other actions the right mouse button has to be hold while choosing a symbol on the bottom of the screen. Besides of fighting the enemies the player has to open several doors - either by finding the key, pressing the right buttons in the right order or using one of his four lockpicks. When using the lockpicks the player has to beat a mini game where he has to make the correct mouse movements. 

When searching the rooms of the dungeon there are various potions, herbs and magical pieces of equipment to be found. With the herbs the player can mix potions or spells, which are available in four categories: Attacking, defending, transforming and item manipulation. There is no free save system, there are special save points during the game. Every time he wants to save the player has to sacrifice one piece of equipment.

156619.overview:
An eccentric old millionaire stored all his gems and money in odd places around his mansion. When he dies, his widow is unable to find any of this, so she hires master thief Devon Aire to look in the places his criminal mindset suggests it will be stored.

Each room of the house is viewed isometrically, and contains all the features you would expect to find in a large house, from cookers and telephones to pool tables and paintings. Each one can be picked up, pushed, pulled and used, with the diamonds located in intricate and surprising places. 

Due to Mr. Croucher's keen interest in experimental science, there are also monsters moving through the rooms. Contact with these reduces some of the energy on one of your 3 lives.

158335.overview: Kids TV show Round the Bend was set in a fictitious comic factory - one with amazingly even more toilet humor than the real things. In this licensed game Doc Croc has blown up the printing press, and Lou Brush must go through the sewers to retrieve all 8 pages. After selecting a section from the initial screen of pipes, gameplay involves moving through scrolling platform sections in order to reach the sheets. Once this is done each page is played out as a single-screen multi-layered screen. The specific settings are influenced by the TV show, including Doc Croc’s Nursery Crimes, The False Teeth Versus the Atomic Banana, and Kenny McTickle and His Magic Kilt.

175141.overview: Designed as a tool to assist dungeon masters in the tabletop role-playing game, Advanced Dungeons & Dragons, this computer program features a database of over 1,000 distinct encounters and more than 1,300 monsters.

175142.overview: The program is designed to assist a game master in managing table-top role-playing games such as Dungeons & Dragons and Tunnels & Trolls. A user can input material into the menu-driven program's tables, including random monster appearances, treasure tables, battle elements, and the creation of new monsters and characters.

177988.overview: The trolls are posing a threat to humanity, and it's your job to sort them out in this traditional-style platform game, which features over 200 screens. You have a gun and bolts of energy available to protect you. The graphics have detailed sprites but very plain backdrops, in an attempt to create a mood. Unusually a construction kit is included, allowing you to design your own levels down to the last detail. Another novelty is the option of mouse control on 16-bit systems, a seemingly impractical option for a platform game.

178121.overview: Diabolik 2: Il Gemma di Salomone is an Amiga arcade 2d adventure game released in 1993 by Simulmondo,, which was released in Europe in 1993. Diabolik is a infamous master thief and anti-hero from the (fictional) Italian city of Clerville. His original personal was a more ruthless approach to getting what he wanted, later becoming more of a Robin Hood, type stealing from criminals and restraining from unnecessary violence.

178122.overview: This is "Elusive criminal", the first episode of the series dedicated to the adventures of the thief-gentleman created by the Giussani sisters. The game is a platformer with adventure elements. The engine is that of the game "Dylan Dog - The killers", which was released in stores before Simulmondo started with the newsstand series. Much of the graphics are quite good for the time and price-point, but the engine itself could be really slow.

178123.overview: Dylan Dog 01: La Regina delle Tenebre is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. Young Pam is possessed by a demon. Doctors, priests and psychiatrists throw in the towel: there is nothing more to be done for a madness that becomes deeper every day. Something terrible lurks behind his curse, but what? The Queen of Darkness is not just the hallucination of a possessed woman, but a monster in flesh and blood, an assassin who has the face of Death itself.

178125.overview: What happens in the Twilight Zone? Dylan Dog must return to Inverary to stop the evil of the mysterious Opal. Inverary, the land where no one is born and no one dies, where every disease is frozen by an eternal immobility ... It is a return to the origins of time itself, a journey beyond death and memory ... beyond the boundaries of the possible.

178126.overview: White night, freezing snow on the tombstones ... Mr. Nobody dies and is reborn. Xabaras the alchemist, Xabaras the sorcerer, has returned again to play with the life of the dead and with the death of the living. But this time it has unleashed forces it cannot control. Not even he knows that even in the heart of any Nobody, suspended between this world and the next, entire universes are hidden ...

181217.overview:
In this follow up to Bomb'X you're a little Dick and your goal is to meet your girlfriends lost in some place. To meet her you should collect the whole pieces of puzzle and get them assembled right.

That puzzle shows no less no more that the face of your girlie. Of course to assemble right the beloved face you should collect every single part of the puzzle and find out an empty nine case puzzle to be able to done it again. As always you can carry only one part with you that means you'll have to be careful when travelling through the weird landscapes.

Your task is being done harder by various type of monsters that keep running after you and often decrease your energy level. But you may shoot them with spits of sperm.

In one player mode the playfield is fullscreen and in two players mode each player gets to play in a tiny portion of window.

Each of 15 levels may be accessed via password and after certain levels the picture of your girl will be shown. High Scores table shows the list of most successful players.

181218.overview:
Your child will have fun placing the countries and capitals of the world on a map thanks to this little program. A voice will guide you aftereach action.

" Nope ! 
"Yes!
" It's wrong ! 

After a while, the voice no longer wanted to speak to me, and the sound of a drum came to sanction each of my mistakes. I finished all my games with a high score... negative.

Today, it is clear that I remain unrecoverable in geography; but it is not the fault of this software, rather well done.

For the more adventurous, there is a game mode in which you will have to rank countries by area, population or GNP per capita (the data is of course from the end of the 80s).

181219.overview:
Decton is a clone of the C64 game Space Taxi. You fly a hovering vehicle in a closed cave, navigating from a base platform to a blue target platform, and back to the base, without touching the walls of the cave or other obstacles.

Your home platform is colored white, the other platforms start out blue, and turn yellow when visited. Only one platform at a time should be visited before you return to your home platform, mimicking a cargo pickup/delivery. Visiting more platforms at a time does not make them all go yellow, only the first counts.

If your vehicle touches anything, it explodes and you respawn on the base platform, continuing as if you completed the last delivery. Once all platforms are yellow, the level is complete and you move on to the next level.

The scoring is both for delivery completion (10 points per visited platform) and time based (a bonus score counts down from 200) and crashing your vehicle does not detract from the score, but you have a limited number of 6 ships to use before it's game over.

181221.overview:
Desert Wolf is an action simulation game. The player is a fighter pilot. The game is divided into a number of single missions with a specified target, such as defending the base, destroying the enemy defense line, chasing enemy transport or bombing a hostile base. The game screen shows the fighter position, weapons/shields status and radar indicating enemy position. The player may use a few types of weapons, depending on the current target of the mission. The ammo is limited and can't be re-supplied. The mission stats show the number of destroyed units and shooting efficiency.

The game has a built-in encyclopedia of military units.

The game was exclusively released in Poland.

181223.overview: Diabolik 3: La Fuga is an Amiga arcade 2d adventure game released in 1993 by Simulmondo in Europe. In Beglait upset by the revolution, Altea is on the run who knows where and Ginko can do nothing to help her. Days of anxiety. Which would become real anguish, if she knew that the threatening presence of Diabolik also hangs over her.

181224.overview: Diabolik 4: Trappola D'Acciaio (or the steel trap) is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993.

181225.overview: Diabolik 5: Ore Pericolose is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. It is the fifth in the series of isues attached to the "Diabolik - Il Giallo Interactive" series.

181227.overview: Sixth in the  "Diabolik - Il Giallo Interactive" game series. Diabolik, the elusive thief in tights, returns to be talked about with this incredible comic\game series. Count Derasé is a genius in inventing anti-theft devices. A worthy opponent for the King of Terror, determined to seize the crown of his family. No obstacles discourage him, nor induce him to give up. Diabolik is one step away from the goal. But, at that point, the most insidious trap is triggered...

181228.overview: An Italian Language 2D side-view action adventure game created by Simulmondo in 1993. Part of the Diabolik series, a precursor to Diabolik 08: Un Piano Perfetto and a sequel to Diabolik 06: La Notte Della Paura. This game was released in Europe in 1993.

181230.overview: The King of Terror has an indefatigable and often indecipherable wit. Therefore, if he convinces the owners of two impregnable safes to make them even more inaccessible, we should not be surprised: he is only a piece of his he Diaboliko plan ...

181231.overview: Diabolik trapped in a dungeon. Eve is a prisoner in a hermetically sealed villa. Has the most famous crime couple has come to a tragic end!?

181232.overview: Panic, terror, death. They are rampant unstoppable, when the king of underground gambling dens and the king of crime find themselves on the same battlefield.

181233.overview: Mario Tamber's gang has stolen the Sandor sapphire. Diabolik wants to get hold of it and, as always, has a perfect plan. But Elda Varne also has one: ruthless and very cunning, she deceives her own accomplices and even the king of crime sees it very badly.

181234.overview: Diamonds is a Platform game, developed and published by Anco Software, which was released in Europe in 1988.

181236.overview:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has 26 pictures of different Dinosaurs to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. A mix button would "mix" the current color with the 15 other colors and give a total of 256 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Pictures could be printed with, or without, a monthly calendar, description, message, banner, etc.

181237.overview: A colorful, electronic version of the tabletop dominoes\bones game, created by Brian Moats and released in 1997 by Polygot.

181239.overview: Dreenshar: Dzieło Magów is a dungeon crawler RPG. As a humanoid creature created by magicians gathering moments before their death, the player must save the city from the forces of chaos. Character creation includes selections from ten races and ten classes available. The game's protagonist is described by three primary (strength, stamina and magic) and three secondary (attack, defense, level of experience) factors, and may be equipped with various clothes, weapons, belts, magical potions. The gameplay screen is divided into environment window, options panel, direction arrows and dialog box. The game features built in level map.

181240.overview: In the forest of Shin, the crowns of the trees dance in the wind and the night is filled with whispers and ... shadows. They are black ghosts without a master and without a body, dark forms animated by hatred. Who brought these bizarre horrors to life? Why do they kill children? Psychic Georg Roll knows the answers, but he can't confide them to anyone. Not even to himself.

181241.overview: Hieroglyphs and corpses: an ever-present recipe. Masked priests - the sinister Sons of Seth - want to bring the ancient mummy of Nectas back to life by practicing human sacrifices in the heart of London. Dylan, however, is not convinced. Someone is playing a double game and using the Egyptian mysteries as screens for personal revenge. But the killer will have to deal with ... the Mummy.

181242.overview: The keepers are falling one by one. Witches, wizards and occultists from all over the world are murdered by a mysterious Angel of a Thousand Faces. Blonde Kim - an old acquaintance of Dylan's - and her magical cat Cagliostro are the last ones left. But what do they keep? The Maelstrom, a black vortex, is a door to Hell, which opens every six hundred and sixty-six years. This time cosmic forces are at stake and the Investigator must decide who to trust: the witch Kim or the Exterminating Angel?

181243.overview: The uncertain step, the cold hand and an insatiable hunger for living flesh. The dead come out of the grave to visit us; Sybil Browning knows something about it, narrowly escaping the jaws of her deceased husband. The only one who can help her is a bizarre detective who plays the clarinet and cultivates a passion for monsters and mysteries; his name is Dog, Dylan Dog. The Nightmare Investigator and the inseparable Groucho follow the step of the zombies to the village of Undead, where the Mephistophelic Xabaras awaits them ...

181244.overview:
In the future, the resources of the Earth are depleted. Therefore a giant company named Dynatech was created to secure the demands of Earth through the discovery and development of distant worlds.

The player is a business man, who wants to have a share of the huge profits that are to be made by this policy. To achieve this goal, he can buy facilities and spaceships from the Dynatech corporation. The player must compete in the interplanetary market and sometimes in cooperation with the opponents to extract the raw material and develop customer products, food or machines.

The game is very trade-based and concentrates around the logistics of a demand-and-supply economy. There are no further gameplay options like piracy or combat, it focuses only on trade and production. The game runs in real-time and can be played by two players at once on computer. It can be compared to the modern Patrician series or the The Port Royale series.

181530.overview:
Decimal Dungeon is a educational math game for one or two players.

Designed to teach students about decimals and fractions, the player must help navigate a man through a haunted dungeon. Numerous stalagmites block the player's path, but if the player correctly answers a math question, the stalagmites will temporarily lower to the ground allowing the player to pass. If the player answers incorrectly, they are dumped through a trap door by a bat. The goal is to reach the top of the levels by continuously answering questions correctly. It contains three levels of difficulty, and a variety of different math problems including converting fractions, decimals, and percentages, as well as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division questions.

181532.overview: Denver Présente: Je Fais Des Couleurs (Denver Presents: I Make Colours) is an educational title by Loriciels. It is a interactive colouring book which allows you to paint various pictures of the title character Denver. Using the mouse to select your colours and touching the area with the brush you wish to  paint with your chosen colour.

181614.overview: Dylan Dog 08: La Clessidra Di Pietra is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. James, a quiet middle-aged employee suddenly turns into a winged monster and tears apart his boring wife, somehow becoming the "director" of a daring time trap for young Sinead, who relives the same events every day aware of such a nightmare, so much so that he turned to Dylan Dog, more skeptical than usual on the proposed case. Several characters are involved in Sinead's nightmare who cross their lives with each other, each with some strange power.

181615.overview: Dylan Dog 09: Il Male is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. A very powerful and lethal contagion in its purest and simplest form is destruction, slaughter, senseless scourge. Whoever meets him becomes his slave and turns into a killing spree without limits. Only Kyle, the brisk American, seems to know his origin ... But can he really stop him? A terrible splatter tale begins for Dylan, in which he must take the Devil himself by the horns. And fight Evil with your bare hands.

181616.overview: Dylan Dog 10: I Vampiri is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. In the light of day, in everyday life, everything seems so "normal". But there is something beneath the surface, something invisible that devours us, hypnotizes us, sucks our blood. Who was Paco Martinez? A drug dealer or the keeper of a terrible secret? Why did the army kill him so lightly? The face of power is clean and smiling, but that smile is made of long fangs ...

181617.overview: Dylan Dog 11: Il Marchio Rosso is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. Yuri Wolkoff does not understand why they accuse him of such monstrous crimes. But with his face marked by misery, he is the perfect candidate for everyone: he can only be the killer, the terrible Red Mark. After his death, however, the doubt begins to grow, winds through the fog like a ghost. And a ghost comes back to kill ...

181618.overview: Dylan Dog 13: I Killers Venuti Dal Buio is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. Jessy has come to London to "become somebody" in show business, but all she has found are three lunatics who want to assassinate her. Sinister figures in black cloaks… What nightmare did they come out of? Why on earth do they really want her? The Nightmare Investigator will find an unexpected solution to this thriller. Because the key is in the powers of the mind, which transports monsters beyond the barriers of time ...

181619.overview: Dylan Dog 15: Inferni is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. What is Hell? A stone in the shoe, a sleepless night, a thought that returns obsessive? What are the Hells and how many are there? Hells can be of different types: desolate or frivolous, insane or ruled by a boring bureaucracy. But even the most careful employees can make mistakes, even the most experienced hell official can get distracted ... And here the dead return to Earth to settle old unfinished business.

181620.overview: Dylan Dog 16: Fantasmi is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1994. Five boys, a boring evening… Why not have a séance? An innocent game becomes a nightmare with no escape, because, by shuffling the cards from the afterlife, you can draw the ace of spades. Peggy and her friends have awakened the rage of the ghosts and now they must flee their revenge. Dylan Dog seeks meaning in this chain of mysterious deaths, because perhaps behind the apparent fury of the dead ... perhaps the madness of the living is hidden.

181674.overview: Denver stars in the puzzle game Denver présente "je découvre les formes", which allows you to choose one out of 24 different pictures (8 of which show vegetables, 8 of which show Denver himself and 8 of which show human characters). The puzzles can have as little as 5 pieces and as many as 80 pieces. The object is to click and drag mixed up pieces from the left side box and put them in their proper place in the right side box. A turn counter will indicate how many turns the player takes to complete the puzzle.

198714.overview: Dungeon Master aid program, focused on helping visualize combat situations.

201561.overview: Damocles: Mission Disk 1 is a data disk for the game Damocles: Mercenary II allowing you to complete more missions and explore the planet Eris and the surrounding Galaxy while the comet Damocles heads for the planet. The game looks and plays like the original game.

201562.overview: Damocles: Mission Disk 2 is a data disk for the game Damocles: Mercenary II allowing you to complete more missions and explore the planet Eris and the surrounding Galaxy while the comet Damocles heads for the planet. The game looks and plays like the original game.

204661.overview:
Dread is a Doom clone by KK/Altair for Amiga 500.
Doom is an FPS game made by id Software and originally released in 1993 for DOS. It was ported the following year for the Jaguar, Linux, PC-98, and the Sega 32X. It was again ported in 1995 for the 3DO and Windows (aka Doom95). In 1996, it was ported for the SNES/Super Nintendo, and in 2001, it was ported for the Gameboy Advance. As for the Amiga, it was, of course, never released for this system​. Until now,​​ that is!

205477.overview: English title translation: THE INHERITANCE 2: THE DIRTY INHERITANCE. Produced for the Umweltbundesamt (Federal Environmental Office). It is the sequel to Das Erbe and like it, it is a point and click adventure game with an environmental theme.

205512.overview:
The point&click adventure "Das Erbe" ("the inheritance") puts you into the place of a youngster whose uncle dies to leave not only three millions in cash, but also an old house. The catch? You'll only get to the money, if you're able to renovate the mansion without any environmental burdens.



The game was published by German environmental authorities back in 1991 and has since been distributed for free.

210551.overview: Dylan decides to go to the undead village where he believes Xabaras is hiding.

210552.overview: Dylan Dog 14: Il Bosco degli Assassini is an Amiga arcade 2d adventure game released in Europe in 1993 by Simulmondo. They emerge from the darkness and descend on travelers like a horde of barbarians. They are the Banda del Bosco, a crew of merciless assassins, mutants with mysterious powers that kill for pleasure. The only survivor of their fury is the young Meggan Page and Dylan must protect her at all costs. But in the depths of the forest, anything can happen, and while the hunt rages, the prey can become a hunter ...

211073.overview:
Earth, 2066. 
At the beginning of the century violent crime was ever increasing,and the world was turning into a death planet at an alarming pace. In an attempt to bring back law and order, in 2036 the Government build Artificial Human Emulators for use in the military and police forces. Crime was not wiped out completely, but it was reduced significantly. Until recently, the world had returned to relative peace. However, there is mounting evidence of these biomechanoid units have been malfunctioning and running on the rampage. They have become more of a threat than the criminals and terrorists they were built to combat. A secret organization was born to combat the biomechanoids, secret assassins that protect humankind.  
 
These brave agents are known as Dark Angels.

211074.overview: Mr. Do coded in Blitz Basic. A clone of Mr. Do!, and a good one. You play as a garden gnome who gets chased by monsters through underground tunnels. To complete a level, either collect all the cherries or defeat all the monsters. After level 10, the game restarts on level 1. There are quite a few different tile sets, bonus items and sound effects thrown in to keep things interesting.

211641.overview:
The Dodgy Game is a very short point & click graphic adventure about a young boy who wants to record the latest episode of his favorite TV show onto his home VCR. To do that, he will first need to get into his house (he's locked out), and prevent members of his family from impeding him in his quest.

The interface splits the screen vertically: the top half shows the current scene, and underneath is a panel that shows the inventory items you are currently carrying, as well as four action buttons: "Look", "Push", "Use" and "Pinch" (as in British slang for "take"). Left-clicking the mouse selects an action button or an inventory item, or causes the main character to walk towards the clicked point on the scene. Right-clicking is used for performing an action on a scene object or character.

211643.overview: Dirty Rackets is a game of the shareware scene, which is a remodelled (and expanded) version of the classic Atari Pong. Now you can play tennis (singles and doubles), soccer and "frontón". The game modes available are the usual for this kind of game (single match and championship), although this time there's also the option of a points league. Game settings are varied too, you can make your racket bigger or faster, choose to play for the points or against time, or 1 vs 1 and 2 vs 2 players. For the nostalgics, there's also an option to play the classic black-and-white Pong.

211681.overview:
In the followup to Das Telekommando, the promotional adventure game made for Deutsche Telekom, you play as a telecom serviceman (or servicewoman) who must repair a video conference connection at the headquarters of a nature protection association. It soon turns out that there has been a sabotage, with everything from the air conditioning to the lifts and telephones being put out of action. You have only your mobile phone and your toolbox to help you out.

First you must repair the lift, then you can roam more freely, talking to the workers of the house, finding clues and performing repairs. The game is very non-technical, and has a very relaxed relation to its sponsor, with the main character sometimes talking like a proud state employee (this was in 1993), rather than a telephone salesman, directly to the player. Still, most puzzles and their solutions revolve around early-90s high tech such as modems, faxes, satellite equipment, mobile phones and videotex terminals.

Telekommando II is a short point-and-click adventure that takes place entirely within the confines of one building. You have your typical inventory and list of verbs at the bottom. There are only 7 verbs at your disposal. One difference compared to the LucasArts adventures is that you can't walk your character around the screen. He or she will only walk when it's necessary for completing an action you've chosen.

211683.overview:
In Drelbs, a set of randomly-arranged lines are already in place on the screen, and moving your character into contact with them pushes them in the direction of contact. Forming a complete square locks it into place, and it turns into a barrier. After a certain period of time, a monster may appear in a barrier which results in death if you make contact with it. After a little while the monster disappears taking the barrier with it.

After producing enough squares/barriers, one will randomly change into a stairway, which can lead you into a bonus room. Making things harder are the enemies which chase your character around the screen, again contact with these results in death.

This game is a free remake of the classic 8-biy Synpase Software game of the same name.

211687.overview:
Das Telekommando is a point-and-click adventure where the player takes the role of a communication technician working for the Telekom. His job is repair technical devices like distribution boxes for example in a German town named Sabbelheim. To reach his destinations he can use a small white service van by selecting his goal on a map of Sabbelheim.

It is an advergame for a German communications company. Its intent is to give an insight to the job of a communications technician working for the Telekom.

211706.overview: German game released as a promotional item and coded in AMOS. It is a multi-screen platformer.

211716.overview: A Dizzy style platform adventure created using the Reality Software Construction Kit by  David Crookes in 1997.

211770.overview: Six worms drawing lines with holes, and trying to kill each other. From 2 to 6 players drive their worms on the game surface, each trying to survive longer then the others. A worm dies when it hits the curve drawn by another player. When there is only one player left, a round is finished. The curve drawn by the worms contains spaces so that longer game is possible.

211798.overview:
A role-playing game written in F-BASIC. Game map design by David G. Boelema; additional map design by Brandon Holmes; and game ideas by Scott Millin and Brandon Holmes. Coding by David L. Timmer. Graphics/animation by David A. Huang. Game features savegame support (savegame disk creator is contained on disk 4) and a quit back to WB option. Shelober's Quest for a Babe is a top down perspective RPG game, where the player must help Shelober find all 5 of the parts required for the ultimate mating call burp. The action takes place in a Labor - Land labyrinth. Shelober is described by two character factors (health, strength) and three possession factors (bucks, chunks, keys). He can carry and use various items, read messages, search objects and engage enemies. The fight screen is divided into action part, commentary part and stats part. Shelober may hit the enemy or scream, forcing him to move one step back. Bucks, chunks and keys are required to reach closed parts of the maze and may be used as currency.

The game features 30 levels in total and over 25 types of monsters.

211806.overview: Doktor is an Amiga puzzle brain game released in 1998. A Dr.Mario clone with really good backgrounds ripped from a slideshow of C42/Silents.

211837.overview: A full motion video game, like playing a grainy movie.  inspired by Tomcat Alley on the Sega CD. First with Tomcat; a very limited demo game, in 1994, and then Desert Apache in 1995. The atmosphere in this was very impressive for its time, but gameplay is limited to choosing targets on a map, and manually aiming a crosshair to destroy them. The whole game plays like a short movie,

211840.overview:
Diamond Caves is a clone of the Amiga game Emerald Mine which is a conversion of the classic Boulder Dash. The player is in a cave and has to collect diamonds for the exit to open. Each finished level unlocks the next one.

The game features several different level groups, some specially designed to be played in coop-mode. A level editor is available too.

211843.overview: A fast paced Gauntlet inspired game by McCheeseBob for the Amiga created in just three weeks.

211846.overview:
The ancient Japan. A land of magic and mystery, a land of betrayals and friendships. 
In those distant days, two families fought for the control of the land. The Tuzobako family, a family of samurais and the Yatekoji, a ninja family. Among the members of these families were two young men: Kojiro Tuzobako and Yamimoto Yatekoji, unlike their parents, they were not interested in war. They were romantics, and when they came of age they traveled around the world. While away, an evil warlord named Tunami decided to conquer the land of their families. And so he did, killing everyone in the process...  
 
Hearing of the carnage, the two banded together to defeat this powerful, common enemy.  
 
Game also released on Amiga Classix 3 compilation.

211847.overview: A well done vertically scrolling shooter created by Robert Giavas and published in Amiga Format in 1995. Mission objective is to penetrate enemy defense system and destroy majority of active targets. Strictly volunteers only.

211899.overview: The game is an updated version of Diamond Fever, and is a breakout or pong type arcade action game. Game design & coding by Ronald Mayer.

211900.overview:
Donkey Downfall is an anti-platformer, where your goal is not to jump up to the next platform, but to fall. Controlling a Donkey Kong sprite, you must walk off platforms while the screen slowly scrolls downward. If you wait too long, you will scroll off the top of the screen and be squashed, or if you are impatient, you fall off the screen and die. As you land on the next platform, it is pushed down by your weight and the scrolling stops for a split second.

Initially Released at Solskogen 2014 in Norway

211997.overview:
Dodge, dodge, dodge, dodge and ... uh ... dodge!

Crazy high-speed endless arcade thing-dodging in an 8-bit style. You'll just have to have one more try!

Dodge the rocks and other projectiles coming your way for as long as possible. Dodge, dash, kick and smash your way out of tight spots to survive just one more wave. Discover and master advanced moves to rack up your bonus and climb the online leaderboards, before testing yourself against the next difficulty level. Are you ready for NIGHTMARE? We don't think you are.

Dodgy Rocks. How dodgy can you get?

211998.overview: A crosshairs shooter where ducks fly from the left to the right side of the screen. The top bar indicates how many ducks you have to shoot and how many shots you are allowed to miss. These parameters change from level to level. The digitized landscapes in the background change as well.

211999.overview: The good new is, you can choose any of five worlds to start from. The aim is to shoot enemies to paradise them, making sure they are in a position where you can kick them in to a cauldron. Then they seem to respawn until the Baddies Left reaches zero.

212000.overview: Dust Digger is a Boulder Dash clone with the usual features. You dig tunnels in the dirt, picking up diamonds while avoiding the green spiders. Spiders can be killed by dropping rocks (or diamonds) on them, but so can you. On each level, you must collect a set number of diamonds, and the key to the port, before you can pass through the exit to the next level. If you get trapped behind some rocks, you have a self-destruct button to restart the level.

212001.overview: You have to match up the colored boxed puzzle game with backgrounds from Sesame Street.

212002.overview: A Bomberman clone created by Andre Wiethoff and released to PD in 1992.

212067.overview: A pooch themed and doggone good, scrolling platforming game by Virtual Vagabonds and released in 1996. Make your way through all the worlds, turning the platforms you walk across to color, showing you have been there. Once all uncolored platform blocks are colored, you are done and can move on to the next location.

212068.overview: It is a fruit machine\slot machine simulator and it does all the things you'd expect from such a game. It does Nudges, hold, gambles, features, and so on. It is a four reel machine, which you don't see simulated that often.

212269.overview: In AD2140, an Egyptian script was discovered that changed mankind's view of the universe forever. It showed the Egyptian gods to be lizard like creatures who change colors and shape constantly, who can shoot beams of light that destroy. It led us to their space facilities and the fight began.

212278.overview:
Don Don Land was our first (and only) real push to make something original and sellable, without copying graphics from other games. The concept came from the first Doraemon game on the PC Engine, where you had to dig holes in the ground to drop enemies in while collecting a certain number of items in the level. We wanted to make something similar, but also something that looked and sounded like it was on a Japanese console. Back then, the influence from Japanese games on western computers was slight - console games were colourful and polished and felt arcade-like. This is what we were after.

We spent many hours drawing the graphics, directing the programming and virtually chaining sunteam_phil to the computer to try and get some music from him. We were quite hopeful - the makers of AMOS seemed keen to market games created with their programming language. In our youthful spirits, we even visited EA and Thalamus to show them what we had done so far. But in hindsight, we were certainly overreaching. Our constant bugbear - the speed of AMOS - was again a killer for the gameplay, the graphics were never as good as we could have made them (our skills being better suited to side-view games rather than overhead), and forcing poor sunteam_phil to use samples from console games for the music was detrimental to its quality. Despite all that, there is a cool little game in there somewhere. The downloadable ADF is not a complete, final version and can be prone to odd glitches and crashes, but is mostly playable. The F-keys will allow you to cheat by giving you various power upgrades, and also skipping levels.

212279.overview:
This is "Downhill Challenge" for the Commodore Amiga released back in 1990 by Deva Soft as Public Domain/Freeware and developed by David Alves. It's a simple and fun to play skiing game. You can find it in Assassins' disk number 6. 
 
Skylar Mountain. Dangerous, steep and downright scary. You were made for this mountain. Ski like the wind, picking up bonus flags as you go. Jump over rocks, branches and bushes for extra points. Avoid hitting obstacles, you can only fall 5 times before being disqualified. The longer you stay up, the faster you ski and the more points you get as you travel.

212280.overview: An AMOS created 2D top down maze game. Walk your character past the hazards, blast the guns and enemies and progress. Hazards on one level may be disabled on later ones and open up more areas to explore.

212281.overview:
DropZone is based on Archer Maclean's classic C64 Defender-style shoot-em-up 'n' save-the-men.

I found that it was the one thing I really pined for when my C64 died, and when I couldn't find any versions for the Amiga I was driven to learn a language and write my own.

It took around two years (sometime in the mid-nineties) to complete, including distractions and hardware breakdowns (and nervous breakdowns and snack breaks). And now it seems to be the only thing I use the Amiga for, when I want a good, sweeping, hyperactive nostalgia-fest. Which is pretty much the reason I wrote it.

212282.overview:
In this game you get to take control of the Doctor and try to find the key to time. The story involves you collecting the 6 pieces of the key to time which are dropped by one of the many adversaries you encounter on each level.

The doctor has only one weapon at his disposal which is his trusty sonic screwdriver which freezes all the enemies on the level for a few seconds. The doctor can trick the monsters into colliding with each other as they try to attack him.Your quest is also hampered by the master who pops up randomly through the game and steals the pieces of the key to time whilst at the same time killing you. Luckily you have 7 lives and each time you die you regenerate into a different incarnation and you have companions to help who are controlled by player 2.

212283.overview: This is a platform game. Your aim is to collect a certain amount of  diamonds in a maze and then reach the exit to finish a level. But beware of baddies walking around. There are 50 levels included.

212293.overview: If you are a fan of Cannon Fodder, Command & Conquer and Supreme Commander you will absolutely love this Amos developed game.  There are various battle scenarios for the game that can be loaded and played, even some where the battle locations are Google Earth locations. In it, you try to take out your enemy and dominate the battlefield.

212303.overview: An updated and somewhat improved version of Defender, with good attention to game feel and play tempo in matching the arcade original, but with a whole new look and several new threats.

212304.overview: Avoid obstacles with your living blob. Published in Amiga Format Magazine Cover Disk 116b.

212339.overview: Bamber's Fighting Clone - Duel Sword Doods, fight and win 9 times to become the supreme champion.

212444.overview: Catch the drip and fill your bucket first.

212445.overview: A copy of the arcade classic with extra freedom of movement in the horizontal direction and walls to crash into.

212446.overview: You control Garf, a dungeon delving adventurer. Beware the Snotlings, these annoying creatures roam the mazes often colluding and stunning take keys from you! Collect these keys to open any doors. Portals transport you to the next level.

212447.overview:
Dungeon Explorer is a fun RPG game that is similar to Vampyr, although more fun thanks to more diverse gameplay. A top down action\adventure with music and sounds. Fight the creatures, find the items, you know what to do!
-Auto room mapping
-Choice of Male\Female characters
-3 adventures with 44 rooms each
-Editor included for making your own adventures
-Choices of music

212479.overview: The most ambitious work of the game world is undoubtedly this game version of the adventures of ancient Odysseus. The large Greek is squatting in the pub with three buddies at the beginning, fully singing the night and philosophizing about how he could finally end the years of siege of Troy. Then the innkeeper suddenly begins to talk of the enchanted cellar underneath the drinkers , which is said to house an oracle in addition to unspeakable dangers.

212481.overview: Excellent strategy game this, closely based on the Avalon Hill board-game of the same name. The author (Steve Douthat) knows how to clone games properly though - the instructions on playing the game are not available on the disk, because they're proprietary to the board game. Even if you don't know how to play (and I certainly didn't) after an hour of mouse clicking you get the hang of it.

212483.overview:
Destination Moonbase is a single player, keyboard controlled Lander variant

In this game the player must successfully land on one of the three moonbase landing pads within the time limit. The game has three levels of difficulty and the time, rate of decent and number of craft varies as the game's difficulty increases.
There are two screens to the game.
The first screen sees the lander positioned below the orbiting space station, from here the lander must be rotated before the engines are fired otherwise it will shoot upwards into the space station which will destroy it. On this screen if the lander goes beyond the right/left border it will reappear on the other side.
The second screen sees the lander approach the lunar surface, here if the craft approaches the right/left border the background scrolls beneath it.

212484.overview: A puzzle game created by Uller Remy (CYB0rG) and released to PD in 1997.

212485.overview: To say it is a Bomberman clone is to take away from this fun game. yna Blaster is a formidable little gem, very polished and well balanced. The Amiga version is a direct port of the NEC PC-Engine original. It has virtually the same graphics, the same sound scheme and, most of all, the same utterly great playability. A similar port exists also for the PC, the Atari ST and the Sharp X68000. The first two are inferior to the Amiga version especially in the sound department, while the latter is identical in every form. In the PC-Engine and the X68000 the game is known as Bomberman. In the Amiga, the ST and the PC, the game is know as Dyna Blaster. The NES version may be heralded as holding the true crown for first Bomberman game, but the PC Engine version, the one that the Amiga and X6800 descend from is the one that made it truly great.

212486.overview:
Puzzle game where you need to join the red dot to all the colored dots and make each dissappear. Once only red dots remain then you can advance to the next puzzle level. 

Co-creator Jonas Norberg went on to create versions of DYNA MATE for BeOS and GBC. According to Norberg, the Amiga version only sold eleven copies.

212487.overview: A nice game of checkers or droughts, this is actually the more simple  for 2 players or play against the computer, created by Barbieri Adrianno and published in the Assassins CD 02 Ultimate Games compilation. Normally "Dama" is the Turkish variant of the game, but this is the more standard anglicized version.

212825.overview: Action game for Commodore Amiga computers. Created with AMOS. Hints: Mow all the lawn and avoid killing the animals.

213430.overview: Drag & Drop is a puzzle game where you place pre-arranged sets of blocks onto a grid. By creating horizontal or vertical lines of blocks which cross from one side of the grid to the other, you gain points and the block lines are removed to make space for more sets. Seven different game modes, including three timed modes, provide different challenges, and a "virus" option exists which randomly removes placed blocks, increasing the game's challenge. The game was developed using AMOS, with source code available with the game.

213692.overview: Platform game for Commodore Amiga computers. Created with AMOS.  Collect the watering cans, go to dry flowers and hold fire button or space key until the flower is better again. When all flowers are OK, go to the “ENDE” sign.

213751.overview: Guide the old wizard through a cemetery haunted by undead knights, skeletons and witches. Use magic bolt to defeat enemies. Somewhere, someone's been tampering with reality again.... Experiments by the evil sorcerer Zecron have opened up a hole into the Demon Dimensions. It's up to you to put a stop to it. Unfortunately the portal can only be closed from the Other side.

213752.overview: A Pengo clone from J. M. Towers in it you must connect the three diamond studded blocks in a straight line, horizontally, vertically or diagonally. This can be done by moving certain blocks around on the screen. This game was released on Amiga Format Disk 67.   It is halfway between a puzzle game and a platform game. The principle is simple, you are a duck in a maze (yes, you can see this kind of thing every day), and you have to bring together three specific squares to align them. It seems easy at first, but soon you realize that it is not! And each level gets a little bit more complex than the first, giving a first class brain puzzle.

213760.overview: Protect the humanoids from invading landers. Landers will attempt to steal humanoids in order to mutate into dangerous mutants. When all 10 humanoids are lost, you must face the hazardous environment of hyperspace! Humanoids are replenished every 5 waves. Pods release deadly swarmers when destroyed. Bombers release mines which must be avoided. Briters appear if you take too long to complete an attack wave.

213761.overview: A Tetris clone from Sam Baker, dubbing himself SamSoft for this 1994 homebrew release. As you play you may have some items that fall that are not your standard Tetris tetrominos. It is up to you to find out what to do with these. You may be given additional instructions as the game goes on, for special challenges.

213771.overview: Unofficially based on 1977 Gremlin/UPL monochrome coin-op DEPTHCHARGE game. Game design & code by Neil Strotton. Depthcharge is a single screen action game where the player is in control of a destroyer and has to destroy as many submarines as possible. The game is viewed from the side with the player being able to move the destroyer left and right along the surface of the sea. Beneath, multiple submarines appear at different depths and at different speeds that the player has to destroy by launching depth charges from the left or right side of the ship.  A maximum amount of depth charges can be used at a time. Submarines eventually fire back at your ship, so watch out for torpedoes and other attacks.

213772.overview: Depthcharge is a single screen action game where the player is in control of a destroyer and has to destroy as many submarines as possible. The game is viewed from the side with the player being able to move the destroyer left and right along the surface of the sea. Beneath, submarines (up to four at a time) appear at different depths and at different speeds that the player has to destroy by launching depth charges from the left or right side of the ship. Each submarine has a number that indicates its point value. A maximum of six depth charges can be used at a time. Submarines release mines that float to the surface and explode. If the destroyer is hit by one the player's score is cut in half. The game lasts 90 seconds and the aim is to get the highest score within that time. If a score is higher than 500 points the time is extended with 45 seconds.

213773.overview: A tile flipping game where the objective is to change a board of tiles into the same number/colour using as few moves as possible. The game was made by Richard "DawnBringer" Fhager and released to Aminet in May of 2001.

213774.overview: Diamonds Mine is a variant of Boulder Dash. The rules remained unchanged - as a miner the player must collect the appropriate number of diamonds and reach the exit before time runs out, while avoiding stones and hostile beings. The game features a number of new elements, such as bombs, rocks distributor, extra life and others. The player may select one of five difficulty levels, game speed and number of lives at the start.

213775.overview: A dicing game created by M. Stewart and released into the public domain in 1993.

213776.overview: Released as part of Amiga Spielesammlung Band 2. As a hero in this jump and run game, you work your way through 50 different levels of difficulty. Two players can play along in this exciting treasure and key hunt, and those who don't have two joysticks can also use the keyboard. Go ahead, defeat the enemy smileys and collect heaps of gems!

213778.overview: A 2D strategy game that could be classed as a map-based historical game that covers the area around the German Empire and related portions of Europe. It was created by Oculus Crew and published in 1990.

213779.overview: Use the shapes to fill the 5x5 board completely, you have 12 shapes to chose from and can flip, mirror and rotate them to your heart's content. A game by Ronnie Simpson that was released to PD in 1990.

213780.overview: A Football\Soccer game in which you can manage train and trade the premier soccer league of 1992. A game by Malcolm Howard aka The Midnight Oil.

213781.overview: A party-shooter where up to 4 players with up to 4 additional CPU players can blast each other and upgrade their fighters for the next round. It was created by Aaron and Adam Fothergill, it features flying ships from World War 1 bi-planes, to hang gliders, to jets and UFOs to boot!

213782.overview: A columns type clone game by Titanics Entertainment, released in 1992.  Like Columns, it involves arranging falling orbs in such a way as to clear them. They are groups of 3 same-size but varying color orbs, which must be arranged into sequences of 3 or more, either horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Sequences of 4 or 5 count for double or triple points, and diagonal sequences score the most. The real trick is to set up 'combos' - where one line causes other blocks to drop so as to create other lines.

213783.overview: A 2D shooter dueling party game for one to four players, but without any computer controlled bi-planes in the sky.

213784.overview: A puzzle game created by David M. Cole and released in 1995. A puzzle where the object is to push boxes to designated locations. Uses HAM mode and is written in JForth. Relative difficulty for this puzzle is easy, but it will take over a half an hour for most people to find the solution. This is version 1.0, binary only.

213786.overview: An adaptation of the classic Domino game for up to two players, created by Fatima Production and later published in "Zestaw gier dla dzieci" compilation.

213787.overview: Standard game of domino with 8-6 set. The computer will provide a challenge to any skilled player. Version includes source in BASIC. Released in both Fred Fish #501 and the July 1991 Memphis Amiga Group (MAG) release.

213788.overview: A one or twp-player, homebrew puzzle game by Lothar Bies and Mirko Winter and released to PD in 1992.

213789.overview: A Pac-Man style collect'em up maze game for one or two players created by Heiko Rutar and released in 1990. This game is a precursor to Don Manolo II.

213790.overview: The Pac-Man like sequel to the first Don Manolo, with coding by Heiko Rutar and released in 1990. Eat dots, avoid ghosts, grab a power pill and eat the ghosts when possible. When all dots are gone you move to the next level.

213791.overview: A puzzle matching game from John Elrick created in 1995.

213792.overview: In 1989, Amiga programmers Syd Bolton & Berj Bannayan coded and released "Dotz", a two-player game for the Amiga based on the classic pen and paper game. They released in 1990 as the first product from Bolton's "Legendary Design Technologies" which went on to do a number of other Amiga projects. The game was released as a shareware title and eventually found its way into much bigger distribution on a cover disk of "CU Amiga" magazine which had a distribution of over 70,000 units a month. It was April 1994, and it was coverdisk 79. It was also published by Euro Power Pack.

213793.overview: Doubletris is a Tetris-Clone for two players, who play simultaneously in one playfield. There is also a computer player but it is really for beginners and practice. Doubletris isn't only able to run in multitasking, it is also the only possibility.  Doubletris was created by Andre Vehreschild and released to freeware in 1996.

213794.overview: Drachensteine is a Shanghai puzzle, tile game, developed and published by Schatztruhe, which was released in Europe in 1994.

213795.overview: Defeat the dragons of the evil wizard Mangoth in order to regain your human form, save the village and allow good to rule the kingdom. An isometric, flying dragon dueling game. First person fry your opponent with dragon breath 8 times, wins.

213796.overview: Was on the Amiga Format coverdisk for Issue 23, June 1991. A racing game where you can design your own course. Any IFF picture will load as a course and let you race it. Pictures with 8 colors or less work best.

213798.overview:
This is a simulation of droids armed with different weapons that move erratically around in an enclosed arena. The arena has a floor of magnets, 
where all the droids can stay powered and fight amongst each other. The colored bullets they fire only works on other colored droids, so those droids that have the same color, is on the same team. The player is the decision maker, and has the range of different droids that he can transfer into the arena by simply pressing a number between 1 and 9. The 2 teams have only limited amount of energy to produce new droids, and every droid has
good and bad properties.

213799.overview: A 2 player duel game based on Battlecars/Carwars, but plays and feels way more like a vs version of Battlezone, it was released as freeware by Vaudeville in 1991, also published in the Software 2000 compilation disk.

213801.overview: A Dizzy clone, developed using the Reality engine. You play as a spaceman called Dylan and have to pick up items to solve puzzles, talk to characters and move through the different scenes until completion.

213817.overview: A very basic Lemmings clone with 7 levels and a Christmas theme created in 2009 by Robert Szacki aka Hexmage960.

213818.overview: A game by Courbois Software, released in 1991. make your way around the maze, avoid the baddies and pick up keys and cash-bags. Shovels allow digging. Dynamite will blow holes in walls to allow access, it will also take out monsters in a pinch, but you have a limited amount, so pick up more when you find it.

213821.overview: The English Football Simulation also known as The German Football Simulation and known as Division 1: Football League Simulator is a Soccer\Football management game. Division One, now's your chance to manage a First Division soccer team and find out what it's like to achieve your ultimate ambition - to lead your team to the top. Every decision you make will be crucial. Do you buy or sell a player, increase the gate money or go for broke with a massive bet? If you are nice to your bank manager, he may finance you, but for how long. Everything you need is in this program. Have you got what it takes to lead your team to the ultimate, the top of Division One?

213930.overview: You are a mouse and there is cheese to be had, unfortunately peril comes along with it in this platformer game created by Andreas Günther in 1991.

214289.overview: The Parker Brothers real estate trading game. All the tokens are here, with up to 8 players, any number of which can be computer-controlled. The rules of Monopoly are included in full, This appears to be an unofficial conversion of an early DOS game version created by Virgin Games.

214622.overview: Is you ever owned a Master System and knew of the secret hidden snail game that some versions of the MS BIOS contained, this is an unofficial conversion with 6 new levels. Instructions on how to make your own levels included. Guide your dodgy snail around the maze to get to the F for finish line. There is a timer, so you had better hurry!

214670.overview: Created by  Conan Mcphee of Katzma in the spring of 1996 as a public domain game, this is a Freeway\Frogger variant action game. As Darryl, you have to prove to your pea-brained peers that you're no chicken. How? By being unreasonably stupid - by running back and forth on the M-11 to core maximum points! Use the joystick to get from one side to the other as many times as possible and grab bonus points by picking up the Golden Katzma statues. See if you can discover Darryl's secret move. If you can, try to work out how to save the almost certainly doomed hedgehog....good luck!

214843.overview: Dragon Slayer was intended to be a sort of Psygnosis Barbarian type of game from Linel, with very large characters wandering around rooms, and hundreds of locations in villages, forests and the castle (which itself would have 300 rooms).  The only way to stop the dragon’s reign is for one particularly brave adventurer to locate the shattered segments of a medallion, access the dragon’s lair and wipe it out. In July of 2020 it was revealed that it will finally be released at some point in the ear future as a complete rebuild by one of the original programmers named as Christian Haller.

214875.overview: A game created by Ralf Buchtmann of Dreamwars and a playable demo released in 1996. It is a two player Arkenoid style game with the two players facing each other on either side of a set of bricks that need to be cleared.

214900.overview: A game created with the Scorpion Engine by Ultra Narwhal in 2022.  it features smooth scrolling, great graphics, multiple enemy types, and much much more! Meet Aura, she's a delivery duck and about to have a life changing day on the job. A client has requested 8 disks be delivered to them, but this won't be an easy task. Using Aura's skills navigate the hostile environment by bouncing on weak foes, even lay an egg to reach higher spots.

214921.overview: A homebrew Dart's game created by Paul Whitehead in the AMOS development environment. It was released as freeware in 1992.
